title: Fin Fisher Charter Services
specs: Captain Shane Britt is fully licensed, insured, CPR and first aid certified
Captain has commercial fishing background and tournament experience
Up to 4 people seating and shade on boat
Flounder gigging max 3 persons, $50 additional for 3rd person
includes: High pressure sodium lights, quiet generator, safety equipment, bamboo gigging poles for flounder gigging
gap: Exact prices for inshore and nearshore trips not stated
blurb: Guests fish for flounder, speckled trout, red drum, and other species depending on season and weather. Trips include navigating rivers, shallow flats, and nearshore reefs using live and artificial baits. Flounder gigging is done at night using lights and gigging poles from the boat.
extraNote: If captain feels weather is unsafe, trip will retreat to inshore waters and prices adjusted

quotes.author: Nadiuska Ramos
quotes.text: This was my very first time fishing and my first charter trip and it couldn’t have been better. I went for a friend’s birthday, and Captain Ian truly made it special. He was professional, friendly, and incredibly knowledgeable. As a complete beginner, I had lots of questions, and he answered them all patiently and without judgment. The scenery was beautiful, and I even caught a redfish! If you’re looking for a fishing charter in North Carolina, this is the one. Captain Ian made the day fun, relaxed, and unforgettable. A fantastic experience from start to finish.

quotes.author: Zach Moore
quotes.text: Had an awesome time with Captain Ian! We were fishing the inland waterways and had a great day catching some beautiful red drum and some nice-sized sheepshead (several not included in picture due to size requirements). Ian was very knowledgeable and personable. I'd highly recommend this charter with Shane or Ian for anyone looking for a fun and successful day of fishing.

quotes.author: Daniel Jones
quotes.text: We booked an inshore with and were very pleased and impressed. Captain Shane and Captain Ian run a top of the line guide service. Both are very friendly and knowledgeable of the areas. Highly recommend fishing with them especially if you have kids in your party. They keep you on fish. We will be booking another trip soon.

quotes.author: Bruce Foerster
quotes.text: We had a great morning out on the water with Capt. Shane aboard his Fin-Fisher charter boat. My wife doesnt do well out in the ocean or other rough body of water so Capt. Shane kept us out of the rough stuff. She did great and caught a bunch of flounder at the same time. We had a great trip... Five Stars!

quotes.author: Eric Schmulbach
quotes.text: Great experience today with Capt. Ian Killefer. We had a 4 hr. intracoastal trip booked fishing for sheepshead and red fish. New experience fishing for sheepshead. Flip casting around docks taught me I need to work on that technique. We had some success and Ian was great. Would highly recommend.

quotes.author: Jennifer Mayberry
quotes.text: We went inshore fishing with Captain Ian today. We had a remarkable day from start to finish. Ian is an expert fisherman and definitely knows his stuff. He is calm, confident, and organized. We caught a ton of fish and had a wonderful time. We will be booking with him again.
